==About==

With the [[Fungiculture]] Skill learned, there is a random chance that when planting {{i|Any Mushroom}} into a {{i|Gardening Pot}} it will instead turn into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}}. A Spooky Redcap can be replanted, but instead of growing another Spooky Redcap, it will turn into one of the other Mushrooms. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Spooky Redcap can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}. Spooky Redcap is a minor [[Restore Food]] for the {{i2|Mushrooms}} Food Group.
